title: Work Tracking Build Plan
eyebrow: Build plan · design approved 2026-10-27 as "background work tracking 1A 2A"
approval: Build plan approved: background work tracking

short.lead: You approved all three layers (choice 1A) with the links pinned in the checklist header (choice 2A). The work is filed as the parent issue "Background work tracking: every layer of delegated work is one tap away" (#396), with five steps under it. The Remote Control issue (#383) is the first step, rewritten to match the design. The build reuses two things the plugin already has: the audit hooks, which find a helper's transcript, and the renderer behind the session ledger. One change from the proposal page: the helper work trail is written by the audit hooks, not by the hook that runs when a helper stops. That hook's output only reaches your screen, so it could never tell the thread where the file is. The systems doc, docs/4-systems/work-tracking.md, records the reason.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it builds and how it is tested.
items: A new hook runs after the start_remote_control tool. When the session has started, it tells the thread to read the session id, then post and attach a link titled "Transcript of the session on your PC", with the raw id beside it. Three tests: the session started, the start is still waiting for your approval, and a session outside a project thread.

The session-start hook builds the thread's link from CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE_SESSION_ID and tells the thread to open every checklist header with it. Three tests: a valid id, no project thread, and a malformed id.

When a helper finishes, the audit hooks write its commands to /mnt/project-files/work-trail/ and tell the thread to attach the file. Tests cover a foreground helper, a background helper, and no project thread.

The end-of-turn hook blocks once when a link from the first three steps (the Remote Control transcript link, the thread's own transcript link and the helper work trails) was never posted, and names it. Tests cover a missing link, a posted link, and the retry.
#399: docs, version 2.74.0 and the QA page
